name: Vault Dweller
description: Born and raised in a vault. You know pre-war technology but not the wasteland.
flavor: "The vault door opens. You blink at the sun for the first time. It's bigger than you imagined."

name: Wasteland Wanderer
description: Raised in the open wastes. Tough and fast but rough around the edges.
flavor: "Home is wherever you dig a shallow grave. You've dug a lot of them."

name: Tribal
description: Pre-war knowledge is foreign to you, but your instincts are razor-sharp.
flavor: "The spirits speak through the static. The metal gods are just old machines. But your spear is real."

name: Pre-War Professional
description: You remember the world before. Knowledge costs mobility.
flavor: "You filed TPS reports. You attended meetings. Then the bombs fell and none of it mattered."

name: Soldier
description: Military training forged you. Combat-ready but institutionalized.
flavor: "They trained the fear out of you. They trained a lot of things out of you. Some of them you miss."

name: Raider Turncoat
description: You ran with bad crowds. Strength and speed remain; trust does not.
flavor: "You've done things. The wasteland made you do them. That's what you tell yourself, anyway."

name: Scavenger
description: A lifetime of finding things others missed. Eyes sharp, body worn.
flavor: "One man's irradiated rubble is another man's treasure. You are that other man."

name: Synth Fugitive
flavor: "The Institute says you aren't real. You've been running long enough to disagree."
